subject.title: [Bug]: exec spawn UNKNOWN after gateway restart — child_process pool not rebuilt

question: Should this issue wait for a current-main Windows reproduction before a fix PR is queued?
rationale: Source contradicts the pool root cause and the remaining failure could be Windows environment/resource behavior, so automation cannot safely choose a code fix without proof.

options.title: Require Windows repro first
options.body: Keep the issue open for a current-main Windows restart recording or logs before implementation work starts.

options.title: Open a hardening task now
options.body: Allow a maintainer-sponsored investigation into transient Windows spawn failures even without reproducing this exact report.
